title: From First Line to First Paper: Mastering Python, Statistical Data Science, and Applied Deep Learning (First Edition)
description: An 860-page, 36-chapter open-access textbook paired 1-to-1 with 182 QA-verified interactive Google Colab notebooks, 324 automated diagnostic checks, 972 three-tier progressive hints (sharukh-tutor), and realistic public health & epidemiological spine datasets. Covers Python from zero, data structures & algorithms, reproducible software engineering, NumPy/Pandas/Biostatistics, classical machine learning, PyTorch deep learning (MLPs, CNNs, GRUs/LSTMs, Transformers & LoRA), multi-seed ablation studies, subgroup fairness audits, Decision Curve Analysis, and TRIPOD+AI reproducible research releases.

creators.name: Sharukh, Mezanur Rahman
creators.affiliation: M.Sc. Statistician | Public Health & Machine Learning Researcher
